flagged.evidence: The proof says the count ratio converges in probability “by Chebyshev” and infers c_z > 0 from “The derivative of t ↦ 1 − t + t log t is log t.” Neither result is in this item's Facts or dependency closure, and neither is derived locally. The available Chebyshev supplier states P(|X − EX| ≥ a) ≤ Var(X)/a²; the logarithm-derivative supplier states log'(x) = 1/x. The claims follow by applying Chebyshev with a = εV and by a routine differentiation, but those proof transitions are not licensed as written.
